description: Source code implementing the SPAKE2 protocol using Curve25519, including precomputed points, context management, and message processing functions.

methods.name: SPAKE2_CTX_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new SPAKE2 context with specified role and participant names.

methods.name: SPAKE2_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a SPAKE2 context.

methods.name: SPAKE2_generate_msg
methods.description: Generates a SPAKE2 message based on the context and password.

methods.name: SPAKE2_process_msg
methods.description: Processes a received SPAKE2 message and derives a shared key.
